spans.s: mf(आ)n. (√ भा) resembling, like, similar (ifc.), MBh.; R. &c. (sometimes pleonast. after adj., e.g. चारु-निभानन, ‘handsome-faced’, Hariv., or comp. with a synonym, e.g. नग-निभोपम, ‘mountain-like’, MBh.; पद्म-पत्त्राभ-निभ, ‘like a lotus-leaf’, ib.)
or n. appearance, pretext (only ifc. instr. Daś.; abl. Kathās.).
नि-भ—ता f. similarity, likeness, RPrāt.
नि-√ भञ्ज् P. -भनक्ति (aor. न्य्-अभाङ्क्षीत्), to break or dash to pieces, Bhaṭṭ.
नि-˚भञ्जन n. breaking to pieces or asunder, AV.
नि-भर्त्सन, नि-भर्˚त्सयत्, w.r. for निर्-भ्˚.
नि-भर्त्सन, नि-भर्˚त्सयत्, w.r. for निर्-भ्˚.
नि-√ भल् P. Ā. -भालयति, ˚ते, to perceive, see, ChUp.; Bālar.
नि-˚भालन n. seeing, perception, L. (w.r. नि-फ्˚).
having the hinder parts directed downwards, TāṇḍyaBr.
नि-√ भिद् (Pass. -भिद्यते), to be opened, open, BhP. (v.l. अनु-भ्˚).
नि-√ 1. भुज् P. -भुजति, to bend (head and knees), Pat.
past, gone, L.
quite frightened, A.
(?) m. N. of Viṣṇu, VS.
borne or placed down, hidden, secret, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
nearly set (as the moon), Ragh.
firm, immovable, Hariv.; Kāv.; Pur.
shut, closed (as a door), L.
fixed, settled, decided, RV.
fixed or intent upon (comp.), Kād.
filled with, full of (instr. or comp.), BhP.
attached, faithful, MBh.; MārkP.
still, silent, Kum.
quiet, humble, modest, mild, gentle, MBh.; R. &c.
free from passions, undisturbed (= शान्त), Hcar.
lonely, solitary, Gīt.
humility, modesty, MBh. v, 1493 (Nīlak. ‘secrecy, silence’).
(आ), f. a kind of riddle, Kāvyād.
(अम्), ind. secretly, privately, silently, quietly, Mn.; Kāv.; Pañc. &c.
नि-भृत—स्थित mfn. standing out of sight, unperceived, Kathās.
secretly arrived, ib.
of resolute conduct, firm, R.
resolute-minded, resolute, BhP.
having a secret meaning, occult, Śiś.
having the ears fixed and erect (said of horses), Śak. i, 8.
निभृती-√ कृ to keep quiet or unmoved, Kāv.
नि-√ भ्रंश् Caus. -भ्राश॑यति, to cause to fall, strike down, fell, RV. x, 116, 5.
नि-˚भृष्ट See अ-निभृ˚.
